correctness.rationale: The helper implements the inspectable contract from the diff: PR arg and env validation, allow-list loading with [bot] stripping, GraphQL review/thread snapshots with --paginate, head SHA checks before and after each snapshot, and RESULT=/HEAD= emission on all five branches with documented exit codes. CONVERGED correctly requires participants > 0 with zero nonterminal PENDING reviews and zero unresolved allow-listed bot threads, avoiding immediate convergence when no bots participated on the current head; quiet-window timing is derived from allow-listed reviews on the current head and allow-listed open thread timestamps. One-point deduction for unverified runtime behavior (bats skipped in objective evidence) and minor contract/doc gaps: pr-resolve-all.md Phase 4 mirror lists only two bots while bot-allowlist.txt defines seven, and unresolved-thread counting does not filter isOutdated threads.
